info.title: VPS Terminal - Dev
info.description: DEV ONLY. GPT Actions-compatible 29-operation VPS Terminal surface with one reserved slot. Semantic families stay typed at runtime; public request schemas avoid unsupported oneOf bodies. Destructive removeExitedContainer remains separate and exact-ID/evidence-gated.

get.summary: Check DEV VPS Terminal and Docker readiness
Read DEV service version, guidance, mediation and durable-plane status

post.summary: Read or stale-safely upsert one allowlisted DEV target registry entry
post.description: Closed family: read|upsert. read returns registry + SHA-256; upsert requires that expected_sha256 and a complete bounded target entry. Server allowlist, risk/environment policy, atomic write, mediation and readback remain authoritative. No arbitrary config patch or generic args.

200.description: Registry read or verified upsert result

409.description: Stale registry SHA or policy conflict

post.summary: Inspect or advance one SourceLoop capture/write-back record
post.description: Closed SourceLoop family: list|artifact|candidate|accept|reject. Read branches expose journal/artifact evidence; write branches reuse the existing mediated TARGET_WRITEBACK_STATUS transition contract. No arbitrary status, path, command or generic args are accepted.

200.description: SourceLoop list, artifact or verified transition result

post.summary: Run one bounded DEV file operation
post.description: Closed file-operation family: read, create, preview_patch, apply_patch, delete. The server enforces branch-specific fields plus root, capability, stale-SHA, mediation and readback guards. No arbitrary args or shell command is accepted.

400.description: Invalid operation, field set or request

409.description: Stale SHA, existing path or policy conflict

post.summary: Run target-owned validation preset after DEV live patch
Reload an opted-in DEV target with its registered preset
Get DEV operator guidance, advice and relevant VERIFIED lessons
post.description: Caller intent, target_id and signals are advisory/untrusted context. Actual operations are classified and mediated server-side.

200.description: Guidance with advice and lesson matches

post.summary: List, inspect, or read logs for DEV containers
post.description: Closed read-only container family. Branch schemas preserve the prior list/inspect/logs bounds and redaction semantics; no exec or mutation branch exists.

post.summary: Remove one exact exited DEV Docker container without deleting volumes
post.description: Destructive typed cleanup only for a full 64-hex container ID. Server re-inspects immediately before delete, requires exited/not-running/not-restarting and zero mounts/binds, calls Docker delete with force=false and volume removal disabled, then requires verified absence readback.

post.summary: Run bounded argv in a DEV container through enforced mediation
Run target-fixed remote read-only code research through pinned Octocode
post.description: CAP-002 typed research lane. The server fixes target to openclaw-main and the Octocode executable/version; callers can select only an allowlisted remote read-only tool and bounded JSON queries. This operation does not expose a shell, caller-selected target, local search or repository clone.

queries.description: Bounded Octocode query object or 1..5 query objects. Server enforces a maximum serialized size of 1800 bytes.

409.description: Pinned Octocode version mismatch or mediation conflict

413.description: Serialized queries exceed the server bound

502.description: Structured Octocode output invalid or truncated

post.summary: Run a bounded command in a registered DEV target
Start a bounded non-TTY DEV session
Write stdin to a running DEV session
Retrieve relevant VERIFIED DEV lessons for observed technical signals
post.description: Observe-first advisory retrieval. Historical lessons never authorize mutation.

post.summary: Prepare an immutable typed DEV debug-clone approval request
post.description: Server observes the source target/container identity. Caller cannot supply operation, resource, observed state, image or command.

post.summary: Execute an already approved typed DEV debug-clone request exactly once
post.description: Accepts request_id only. The server revalidates approval binding and source identity, creates one clone through the private typed executor, verifies it by readback, and blocks replay.

post.summary: Prepare immutable DEV change request through enforced server-derived preflight
post.description: Caller intent/risk claims do not authorize a change. This call may be blocked before any request is created.

get.summary: Read immutable DEV approval request status

FileActionRequest.description: Closed file-action envelope. read may use start_line/line_count/max_bytes; create requires content; preview_patch and apply_patch require expected_sha256/old_text/new_text; delete requires expected_sha256. The server rejects fields that do not belong to the selected operation.

TargetRegistryActionRequest.description: Closed registry envelope. read accepts only operation. upsert requires expected_sha256 and target; the server rejects branch-incompatible fields.

change_id.description: Required for artifact/candidate/accept/reject; optional list filter.

ApprovalArgs.description: Optional bounded operation arguments. The server hashes the complete object into the immutable request.

ApprovalObservedState.description: Observed pre-change state used for stale-request protection.

resource.description: Exact DEV resource selector. Wildcards are rejected server-side.

operation.description: Requested operation. Risk/effect are derived server-side; caller labels do not authorize it.
